latest_release.name: ZapFast v0.21.1
latest_release.body:
ZapFast 0.21.1 fixes the disappearing messages menu, which 0.21.0 added but never opened, lines up the info panel's header with the chat beside it, and plays videos that some encoders lay out differently.

**Download ZapFast:** [Mac](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.1/zapfast-v0.21.1-macos-universal.dmg) · [Windows](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.1/zapfast-v0.21.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.msi) · [Windows ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.1/zapfast-v0.21.1-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.msi) · [Linux](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.1/zapfast-v0.21.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Linux ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.1/zapfast-v0.21.1-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [AppImage](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.1/zapfast-0.21.1-x86_64.AppImage) · [AppImage ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.1/zapfast-0.21.1-aarch64.AppImage) · [Flatpak](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.1/zapfast-v0.21.1-x86_64.flatpak) · [Debian/Ubuntu](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.1/zapfast_0.21.1_amd64.deb) · [Fedora](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.1/zapfast-0.21.1-1.x86_64.rpm)

On a Mac, `brew install --cask crmne/tap/zapfast`. On Arch, `yay -S zapfast-bin`.

## Fixed

- **The disappearing messages timer opens its choices.** In 0.21.0 the timer in a chat's info panel showed the current setting, but a click or Enter on it did nothing. By @crmne. (#531)
- **The info panel's header lines up with the chat header beside it.** Its edge sat a few points lower, and on the Messages theme, where the chat header has no edge, it drew a line of its own. By @crmne; thanks @ArthurWillers, who reported it. (#639)
- **Videos whose files put the picture's aspect ratio before the decoder's settings play,** in the chat and when sent. ZapFast refused them as unsupported, and some cameras, phones and editing apps write their videos that way. By @crmne.

## Known limitations

- Calls are still a work in progress, as described in [0.20.0](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/tag/v0.20.0): video calls are in alpha, and in group calls your video stops for a moment every few seconds (#592).

## Thanks

@ArthurWillers for the report.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/compare/v0.21.0...v0.21.1

ZapFast

WhatsApp, native and fast.
A lightweight WhatsApp app for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

Download · Getting started · User guide · Contribute

ZapFast is a WhatsApp client written in Rust with [egui](https://www.egui.rs) and [fastframe](https://fastframe.dev), the framework behind a family of native desktop apps. It links to your phone as a companion device through [whatsapp-rust](https://github.com/oxidezap/whatsapp-rust) and has no browser engine. In our Linux test it opens in under a second and uses about 200 MB of idle RAM, against 1.13 GB for WhatsApp Web. [See the measurements](https://zapfast.rocks/benchmarks/). The interface is available in English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Dutch, French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish, and Turkish.

detail.readme:
ZapFast

WhatsApp, native and fast.
A lightweight WhatsApp app for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

Download · Getting started · User guide · Contribute

ZapFast is a WhatsApp client written in Rust with [egui](https://www.egui.rs) and [fastframe](https://fastframe.dev), the framework behind a family of native desktop apps. It links to your phone as a companion device through [whatsapp-rust](https://github.com/oxidezap/whatsapp-rust) and has no browser engine. In our Linux test it opens in under a second and uses about 200 MB of idle RAM, against 1.13 GB for WhatsApp Web. [See the measurements](https://zapfast.rocks/benchmarks/). The interface is available in English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Dutch, French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish, and Turkish.
Watch ZapFast in action https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2bf86b54-45fc-4add-8de7-c426c3cdad9b
[Features](#your-chats-on-your-desktop) · [Install](#install) · [Link your phone](#link-your-phone) · [Help](#guides-and-help) ## Your chats, on your desktop | Feature | What you can do | |---|---| | **Messages** | Send formatted text, replies, edits, reactions, forwards, pictures, files, stickers, GIFs, polls, and voice messages. | | **Media in the chat** | Play voice messages, videos, round video messages, GIFs, and animated stickers in place. | | **Your history** | Keep your chats in an encrypted archive on this computer, fetch older messages from your phone as you scroll, and export locally saved chat history as text or a ZIP with downloaded attachments. | | **Several numbers** | Link more than one WhatsApp number and switch between them in one window. | | **Desktop controls** | Use keyboard shortcuts, select and copy text across messages, and stay linked in the tray with notifications. | | **Themes** | Choose light, dark, system appearance, or custom colours. On Omarchy, follow your desktop theme. | | **Privacy** | Hide locked chats behind a code, or the whole window behind an app lock. Nothing goes to a server of ours. | ## Install | Platform | Installation | |---|---| | **macOS** | `brew install --cask crmne/tap/zapfast`, or [download the Mac app](https://zapfast.rocks/download/#macos). | | **Arch Linux** | `yay -S zapfast-bin` | | **Windows** | Choose your build on the [Download page](https://zapfast.rocks/download/#windows). | | **Other Linux** | Find Nix, AppImage, and other options on the [Download page](https://zapfast.rocks/download/#linux). | | **From source** | Follow [Getting started](https://zapfast.rocks/getting-started/) for dependencies and commands. | ## Link your phone 1. Open ZapFast. It shows a QR code. 2. On your phone, open WhatsApp, then **Settings**, **Linked devices**, **Link a device**, and scan the code. Or click **Link with phone number** and enter the eight-character code on your phone. 3. Your recent chats arrive from the phone. Older messages follow as you scroll up. The link survives restarts, and your phone does not need to stay online to read what ZapFast has already stored. See [Getting started](https://zapfast.rocks/getting-started/) for the full walkthrough and [How it links](https://zapfast.rocks/how-it-links/) for the details. ## Guides and help The complete guide lives at **[zapfast.rocks](https://zapfast.rocks/)**. | You want to… | Read | |---|---| | Know what ZapFast does and does not do yet | [What is ZapFast?](https://zapfast.rocks/what-is-zapfast/) | | Link your phone or build from source | [Getting started](https://zapfast.rocks/getting-started/) | | Learn messages, stickers, polls, and shortcuts | [Using ZapFast](https://zapfast.rocks/using-zapfast/) | | Find settings, stored files, encryption, the app lock, and updates | [Settings and files](https://zapfast.rocks/settings-and-files/) | | Make your own theme | [Making a theme](https://zapfast.rocks/themes/) | | Understand what stays on this computer | [How it links](https://zapfast.rocks/how-it-links/) | | Understand account risk | [Account safety](https://zapfast.rocks/what-is-zapfast/#account-safety) | | Report a bug or propose a feature | Read [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md), then use the [issue forms](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/issues/new/choose). | ## Contributing Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening an issue or pull request. To look at the interface without a WhatsApp account, run: ```sh cargo run --features demo -- --demo ``` [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) describes the architecture, [DEMO.md](DEMO.md) the demo pages, screenshots, and recorded tours, and [PACKAGING.md](PACKAGING.md) releases and packages. Native notifications use Fastframe on Linux, macOS and Windows. ZapFast keeps its account/chat routing, privacy settings, notification limits and sound previews. Clicks open the announced message; reading a chat withdraws its tracked notifications. OS permissions and notification presentation still apply. ## More native apps **Want Spotify just as fast and native?** [Spotifast](https://spotifast.rocks) is ZapFast's sibling. Both are built on [fastframe](https://fastframe.dev). ## Acknowledgements ZapFast uses [whatsapp-rust](https://github.com/oxidezap/whatsapp-rust), [egui](https://www.egui.rs), [fastframe](https://fastframe.dev), the [Inter](https://rsms.me/inter/) typeface and Noto Color Emoji (OFL), and [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) icons (ISC), also used for the chat wallpaper doodles. The notification sounds are [Pidgin](https://pidgin.im)'s, under the GPL-2.0 (see `assets/sounds/`). ZapFast is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. Using an unofficial client may be against WhatsApp's terms of service and could get an account suspended. Use it at your own risk. WhatsApp is a trademark of WhatsApp LLC.
